R1_AGE.title: Age minimum
body: The applicant must be 18 years of age or older on or before the date of the next election.

birth_dates.base: The date of birth on the identity document and the application form must agree.
birth_dates.with_citizenship: The date of birth on the identity document, the application form and any citizenship document must agree.

R2_RESIDENCY.title: South Dakota address
body: The applicant must list a South Dakota residence address on the application form.
An application with no residence address listed is incomplete.

R3_CITIZENSHIP.title: Proof of citizenship
body: Tier 1. The applicant presents one of the following original documents. Photocopies are not accepted.
• A South Dakota driver license that reads "U.S. Citizen" on the back.
• A driver license or nondriver identification card from another state that indicates citizenship has been verified.
• A tribal identification card issued by a participating tribe, listed below.
Tier 2. The applicant presents one of the following. Originals and photocopies are accepted.
• Consular report of birth abroad issued by the U.S. Department of State.
Expired documents are not accepted. The name on the presented item must match the name on the application.
